name: Tomato basil
steps: Chop the onions and garlic, and soften them in the oil for ten minutes.
Add the rest of what makes it tomato basil, and stir for a minute or two.
Pour in the stock, add the bay leaf, and bring it to a gentle simmer.
Simmer, half covered, until everything is tender.
Take out the bay leaf, and blend half of it if you like it thick.
Season with salt, pepper and a squeeze of lemon.
Serve hot, with the herbs on top and good bread on the side.
It keeps for three days in the fridge, and tastes better on the second.
